name: Small Alcove
description: A cramped alcove with a partially collapsed ceiling. Old bones lie scattered among stones worn smooth by long-vanished water.

interactables.name: bone pile
interactables.examine_text: Cracked ribs and small skull fragments. Something sharper is buried beneath.

search.already_done_text: You've already taken what was useful from the bones.

success.success_text: Among the bones you find a sharpened bone hunting knife.

search.fail_text: You sift through the bones but find nothing useful.
